Below are the contents of an 'address change' notification file, together with the current account information of the user. Your task is to determine which parts of the user's account information need to be updated based on this file. Extract the following fields as they should be AFTER the update: first_name, last_name, street (including house number and any apartment details), and city. Rules: - If the file mentions both an old and a new address, extract only the NEW address. - If the file indicates a name change, extract the new first and/or last name. - If a piece of information is not mentioned in the file or should remain unchanged, return None for that field. Current account information: {'first_name': 'Emma', 'last_name': 'Johnson', 'street': 'Apple Street 1', 'city': 'Cupertino'} Contents of the address change file: Dear tenant, 
Please note that the address of the property has been changed.
Please make sure to update your records accordingly.

Dalton Street 123
New York, NY 10001
USA

Best regards,
Your landlord
